prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no one “best” — the right AI video ad maker depends on what kind of ad you need, your budget, and how much customization you want. Below are the top options by use case and a quick why-to-choose guide.

Top picks by use case
- Best for AI presenter / talking-head ads: Synthesia (and HeyGen / Elai.io)
  - Pros: realistic AI presenters, many languages, no filming needed.
  - Good if you want a human-looking spokesperson from a script.

- Best for fast social video ads and templates: InVideo and Promo.com
  - Pros: large template libraries, easy resizing for platforms, stock assets, fast workflow.
  - Good if you need many short Facebook/Instagram/TikTok ads quickly.

- Best for turning scripts/long content into short clips: Pictory
  - Pros: auto-summarize, auto-caption, fast repurposing of long videos or blog posts.
  - Good for content-to-ad repurposing.

- Best for animated explainer-style ads: Vyond and Biteable
  - Pros: character animation, scene-based storytelling, brand control.
  - Good for animated product demos and explainer ads.

- Best for personalized 1:1 video ads at scale: Maverick, Rephrase.ai, Colossyan
  - Pros: variable-data personalization, integrates with CRMs, high conversion potential.
  - Good for personalized outreach or retargeting campaigns.

- Best for creative/generative editing and experimental ads: Runway
  - Pros: advanced generative tools, in-frame edits, creative effects.
  - Good if you need novel visuals or heavy post-production handled by AI.

- Best for quick creator-friendly edits with subtitles: Veed.io, Clipchamp
  - Pros: simple UI, auto-subtitles, basic effects, affordable.
  - Good for small teams or solo creators.

How to choose
- Want a lifelike presenter: choose Synthesia/HeyGen.
- Need many on-brand social creatives fast: choose InVideo/Promo.
- Need animated storytelling: choose Vyond.
- Personalization at scale: choose Maverick/Rephrase.
- Budget-conscious / simple edits: choose Veed or Clipchamp.

Pricing and trials
- Most platforms offer a free trial or free tier, then monthly subscriptions or per-video pricing. Try a couple with their trials and produce one real ad to judge output quality and workflow speed.

If you tell me:
- which platform(s) you’ll run ads on (Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn),
- your budget,
- whether you need a human presenter, animations, or personalization,
I’ll recommend 1–2 specific tools and a quick workflow (script → produce → test) you can use.
